title: REQ · StoryPanel is dialog content with larger readable text
summary: StoryPanel drops its full-height panel wrapper and shows dialogue, choices, event log and inventory with larger fonts and full-width choice buttons.
description: Context: StoryPanel.tsx root is sf-frame-panel h-full text-sm sized for a narrow sidebar, with bare h1/h2 and small text. Desired behavior: content sized for a centered dialog: sf-dialog body text, speaker in pixel font, choices as full-width gold buttons. Expected result: dialogue is easy to read. Why: readability.
acceptance_criteria: Given StoryPanel renders a node, when inspected, then the root keeps class story-content and has no h-full or text-sm class.
Given a node with two choices, when rendered, then each choice button has class w-full and the speaker heading has class font-pixel.

preserve: aria-labels Dialogue, Choices, Event log, Story history, Inventory

technical_constraints: Keep the story-content root class (asserted by existing tests)
definition_of_done: StoryPanel readable classes applied and unit tests pass
